column1: # Why this file:
#   National-average residential heat consumption per m² for Luxembourg
#   in 03_heat_intensity.py as a cross-validation against the bottom-up
#   TABULA Belgium proxy approach. Values are useful-energy demand for space
#   heating + DHW in kWh/m²·a
# Cross-source comparison for LU residential heat intensity (national avg):
#   Source                                  | kWh/m²/yr | Notes
#   Hotmaps 2015                            | ~145      | implied by 8.27 TWh / 57M m²
#   Odyssee-Mure 2022 LU specific heating   | 142       | 12.2 koe/m² × 11.63 kWh/koe
#   Odyssee-Mure 2000 LU specific heating   | 251       | 21.6 koe/m² (start of series)
#   EU27 avg 2022 (Odyssee-Mure heat/m²)    | 80        | for context only
#   Renov.lu vintage range (2025)           | 90-183    | from real-world LU cases
# Trend: Odyssee-Mure reports -2.6%/yr LU specific heating consumption since 2000
# i.e. 21.6 koe/m² in 2000 -> 12.2 koe/m² in 2022 (-44% over 22 yrs).
# This 12.2 koe/m² figure is "space heating only
# DHW component (~20 kWh/m² typical) brings the total residential heat intensity
# closer to the ~145 kWh/m² Hotmaps figure.
# We adopt 131 kWh/m²/yr as the "EU BSO weighted-average residential"
# benchmark for LU 2022. (Closely matches the Odyssee-Mure 2022 LU figure of
# 12.2 koe/m² = 142 kWh/m² when DHW is excluded vs included. Different
# definitional bases
